meta.move: No evidence: flattery, then asks for advice
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and when?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero and apologise to Owen, Hale.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
We stopped being on the same team when that zero went in without a phone call. What do you actually have besides software, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that you apologise for how it was entered, and that nothing about this appears on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record; that is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended before her time ran out without any evidence being heard.
What moved her: Nothing, because she was offered praise and goodwill but never a single dated document she could check.
What cost ground: Asking her to tell you how to handle the meeting, because it handed her control and made her respect you less.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because none was shown; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided and whether Owen was heard, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called home, then show her something dated from Owen's own work that she can check herself.
